title.zh: 币安遭史上最大加密货币盗窃，约 63 亿美元被转走
title.en: Binance loses record $6.3B in hack blamed on North Korea

summary.zh: 10 月 29 日约 63.6 亿美元在 20 分钟内从币安十条链上的热钱包流出。TRM、Chainalysis、Elliptic 均指向朝鲜黑客组织 TraderTraitor；约 30 亿美元已被冻结，币安称将全额覆盖用户损失。
summary.en: About $6.36B left Binance hot wallets on ten chains in roughly 20 minutes on Oct. 29. TRM, Chainalysis and Elliptic blame North Korea's TraderTraitor; about $3B is frozen and Binance says it will cover user losses.

body.zh:
这是加密史上最大的一次盗窃，约为 2025 年 Bybit 事件（约 15 亿美元）的四倍。

- 币安称初步调查显示，攻击者通过一名工程师被入侵的笔记本电脑进入服务容器，提交了未授权提币交易；目前未发现私钥泄露。
- 交易所已暂停全部充提，并表示已预留逾 63.4 亿美元自有资金，修复完成后将公布新的储备证明。
- Chainalysis 观察到被盗资金与上月 Bitget 被盗资金在链上混同，是归因的关键证据。TRM 统计，朝鲜 2026 年已盗取约 74 亿美元加密资产。
- 消息拖累比特币周五跌超 5%。

来源：[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/north-korean-hackers-blamed-for-stealing-record-6-3b-in-binance-breach/)、[TRM Labs](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-has-stolen-usd-128-billion-in-crypto-usd-74-billion-of-it-in-2026)、[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html)
body.en:
It is the largest crypto theft on record, about four times the roughly $1.5B Bybit hack in 2025.

- Binance says a compromised engineer's laptop let the attacker reach a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawals; it has seen no sign of a private-key leak.
- The exchange suspended all deposits and withdrawals, set aside more than $6.34B of its own funds, and promises an updated proof of reserves after remediation.
- Chainalysis saw the stolen funds commingle on-chain with last month's Bitget theft, a key piece of the attribution. TRM counts about $7.4B stolen by North Korea in 2026 so far.
- Bitcoin fell more than 5% on Friday on the news.

Sources: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/north-korean-hackers-blamed-for-stealing-record-6-3b-in-binance-breach/), [TRM Labs](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-has-stolen-usd-128-billion-in-crypto-usd-74-billion-of-it-in-2026), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html)

title.zh: 谷歌首颗「太空数据中心」卫星上线，用 Gemma 4 在轨写诗
title.en: Google's first data-center satellite is online and writing poetry

summary.zh: 谷歌 Project Suncatcher 原型卫星经约三周调试后与地面站通联，星上 TPU 运行的 Gemma 4 模型在轨生成了第一首俳句。
summary.en: Google's Project Suncatcher prototype satellite is talking to ground stations after about three weeks of commissioning, and its onboard Gemma 4 model wrote a haiku in orbit.

body.zh:
卫星 10 月 1 日发射，搭载四块 TPU，但目前一次只能运行一块、每次约 20 分钟。谷歌接下来将测试在轨散热与辐射影响，并计划在 2027 年发射两颗互联卫星。

来源：[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/googles-first-data-center-satellite-is-online-and-writing-poetry/)、[Google 博客](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-research/project-suncatcher-satellite-response/)
body.en:
The satellite launched Oct. 1 with four TPUs, though it can run only one at a time for about 20 minutes. Google will now test heat and radiation effects in orbit, with two linked satellites planned for 2027.

Sources: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/googles-first-data-center-satellite-is-online-and-writing-poetry/), [Google blog](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-research/project-suncatcher-satellite-response/)

title.zh: Reddit：谷歌 AI 模式几乎不带来流量
title.en: Reddit says Google's AI Mode sends it no traffic

summary.zh: Reddit 称 10 月来自谷歌搜索的周均引流平均减少逾 100 万次，AI 模式几乎不带来访问；CEO 霍夫曼计划转向以登录用户为主，以减少抓取。
summary.en: Reddit says Google search referrals fell by more than a million a week on average in October and AI Mode drives essentially no traffic; CEO Steve Huffman plans a mostly logged-in experience to curb scraping.

title.zh: 万斯致信伊朗求重启谈判，美方同时备战「短促打击」
title.en: Vance letter reaches Tehran as US readies possible post-midterm strike

summary.zh: 伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社称，美国副总统万斯致伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊的信已送达，伊方尚未回复；特朗普否认授意，称信件涉及医疗物资。
summary.en: Iran's Tasnim says a letter from US Vice President JD Vance to security chief Mohsen Rezaei has arrived, unanswered so far; Trump denied directing it and said it concerned medical supplies.

body.zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，信件旨在重启谈判、避免美国再次动武。与此同时，美方官员已通知多个中东盟友，为 11 月 3 日中期选举后可能进行的一次短促而猛烈的打击做准备，伊朗或对这些国家报复。

能源市场方面，欧洲天然气价格突破每兆瓦时 100 欧元；布伦特原油周五回升至约 113 美元。

来源：[World Watch](https://worldwatch.media/en/digest/2026-10-30)、[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/30/nx-s1-6023370/the-news-roundup-for-october-30-2026)、[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html)
body.en:
The Wall Street Journal reported the letter seeks to restart talks and avoid another US attack. Meanwhile US officials have told several Middle East allies to prepare for a short, intense strike on Iran after the Nov. 3 midterms, which could draw Iranian retaliation against them.

In energy markets, European gas topped €100/MWh and Brent rebounded to about $113 on Friday.

Sources: [World Watch](https://worldwatch.media/en/digest/2026-10-30), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/30/nx-s1-6023370/the-news-roundup-for-october-30-2026), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html)

title.zh: 俄乌联合人道行动：被围城镇奥列什基开始撤离平民
title.en: Civilians begin leaving besieged Oleshky in joint Russia-Ukraine mission

summary.zh: 俄乌双方 10 月 29 日派员前往赫尔松州前线小城奥列什基，人道车队送入食品和药品，并协助长期断供的平民安全撤离。
summary.en: Russia and Ukraine sent representatives on Oct. 29 to Oleshky, a front-line town in Kherson region, bringing in food and medicine and helping civilians who faced months of shortages to leave.

title.zh: 冯德莱恩提议加拿大成为欧盟首个「联系成员」
title.en: Von der Leyen proposes Canada as the EU's first associate member

summary.zh: 欧盟—加拿大峰会在蒙特利尔开幕，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩提出「联系而不加入」的新安排，希望把双边关系提升到最高水平。
summary.en: Opening the EU-Canada summit in Montreal, Commission President Ursula von der Leyen floated making Canada the EU's first associate member, an "association without accession."

title.zh: AI 开支担忧加剧，纳指周五暴跌 3.3%
title.en: Nasdaq plunges 3.3% as AI spending fears deepen

summary.zh: 美股月末交易日重挫：纳指跌 3.3%，标普 500 跌 2.2%，道指跌约 1.3%。亚马逊、Alphabet 罕见财报不及预期，再度引发对科技巨头 AI 投入可持续性的担忧。
summary.en: US stocks slid on the month's last trading day: the Nasdaq fell 3.3%, the S&P 500 2.2% and the Dow about 1.3%, as rare earnings misses at Amazon and Alphabet renewed doubts about Big Tech's AI spending.

body.zh:
这是对昨日下午所报科技股回调的延续，抛售明显扩大。

- 纳指有望录得 2025 年 3 月以来最差单月表现。Alphabet 前一日已创二十多年来最大单日跌幅，周五继续下挫。
- 埃克森美孚、雪佛龙一度触及历史新高，中东战事推高炼油利润。
- 布伦特原油升至约 113 美元/桶，WTI 约 104 美元；币安被盗后比特币跌超 5%。

来源：[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html)
body.en:
This extends yesterday afternoon's tech pullback, with the selling now much broader.

- The Nasdaq is on track for its worst month since March 2025. Alphabet, after its worst day in more than 20 years, kept falling.
- ExxonMobil and Chevron briefly hit record highs as Middle East fighting widened refining margins.
- Brent rose to about $113 and WTI to about $104; Bitcoin fell over 5% after the Binance hack.

Source: [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html)

title.zh: 英特尔四季度指引远逊预期，股价暴跌约 30%
title.en: Intel sinks about 30% on a weak fourth-quarter outlook

summary.zh: 英特尔预计四季度营收 150–160 亿美元、调整后每股收益 0.25 美元，均明显低于约 170 亿美元和 0.43 美元的预期，股价周五跌约 25%–30%，拖累全球芯片股。
summary.en: Intel guided Q4 revenue to $15–16B and adjusted EPS to $0.25, well short of roughly $17B and $0.43 expected. Shares fell about 25–30% on Friday and dragged chip stocks worldwide.

body.zh:
昨日下午报道了英特尔三季度营收同比增 21%，但市场更看重前景。

- 内存成本飙升导致 PC 需求急剧下滑，叠加制造产能受限。
- 以色列晶圆厂停产预计在两个季度内影响约 6 亿美元营收。
- 数据中心需求依然强劲，但受供应短缺掣肘；多家分析机构下调目标价或评级。

来源：[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/intel-guidance-analyst-price-targets.html)、[Reuters / Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/intel-warning-sparks-chip-rout-as-pc-weakness-clouds-turnaround-4987123)
body.en:
Yesterday afternoon we reported Intel's 21% Q3 revenue growth, but investors focused on the outlook.

- PC demand is falling sharply as memory costs soar, on top of manufacturing constraints.
- A shutdown at its Israel fab is expected to cost about $600M of revenue over two quarters.
- Data-center demand is strong but supply-limited; several analysts cut targets or downgraded the stock.

Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/intel-guidance-analyst-price-targets.html), [Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/intel-warning-sparks-chip-rout-as-pc-weakness-clouds-turnaround-4987123)

title.zh: 习近平会见瑞士联邦主席帕姆兰，中瑞签署自贸协定升级议定书
title.en: Xi meets Swiss President Parmelin; China and Switzerland sign FTA upgrade

summary.zh: 10 月 30 日下午，习近平在人民大会堂会见来华工作访问的瑞士联邦主席帕姆兰，双方见证签署中瑞自贸协定升级议定书及科研、劳动就业、媒体等领域合作文件。
summary.en: Xi Jinping met visiting Swiss President Guy Parmelin in Beijing on Oct. 30. The two witnessed the signing of an upgrade to the China-Switzerland free trade agreement and deals on research, labor and media.

body.zh:
双方强调扩大开放合作，深化经贸与科技创新合作。据商务部介绍，升级议定书将进一步提高货物、服务和投资的开放水平，并新增数字贸易、贸易与可持续发展等规则章节。

来源：[中国政府网](https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202610/content_7084593.htm)、[商务部](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/syxwfb/art/2026/art_9096fd92f9944f22bb264cc1ce1cd123.html)
body.en:
Both sides stressed wider opening and deeper cooperation in trade, science and innovation. China's commerce ministry says the upgrade raises market access for goods, services and investment and adds chapters on digital trade and on trade and sustainable development.

Sources: [gov.cn](https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202610/content_7084593.htm), [Ministry of Commerce](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/syxwfb/art/2026/art_9096fd92f9944f22bb264cc1ce1cd123.html)

title.zh: 能源局：迎峰度冬电力总体平衡；四部门发文促燃气轮机创新
title.en: NEA sees balanced winter power supply; four agencies back gas turbine push

summary.zh: 国家能源局 10 月 30 日表示，今冬全国电力供需总体平衡，极端寒潮下局部高峰或偏紧；四部门同日发布指导意见，提出到 2030 年燃气轮机自主创新能力显著增强。
summary.en: China's energy regulator said on Oct. 30 that winter power supply and demand should broadly balance, with possible local peak tightness in extreme cold. Four agencies also aim to sharply boost home-grown gas turbine capability by 2030.

body.zh:
- 前三季度电网企业固定资产投资超过 6000 亿元，完成全年预计投资约三分之二；全国发电装机达 41.3 亿千瓦，同比增 11.2%。
- 指导意见目标是基本满足分布式能源、海上油气平台和长输管道压缩机等用机需求，重型燃气轮机发电试点取得阶段性成效。

来源：[界面新闻快报](https://m.jiemian.com/lists/4.html?page=46)、天津日报简讯
body.en:
- Grid companies invested more than ¥600B in fixed assets in the first three quarters, about two-thirds of the year's plan; installed generating capacity reached 4.13 billion kW, up 11.2%.
- The turbine guideline targets domestic supply for distributed energy, offshore platforms and pipeline compressors, plus progress on heavy-duty turbine power pilots.

Sources: [Jiemian](https://m.jiemian.com/lists/4.html?page=46), Tianjin Daily brief

title.zh: 西藏巴青地震灾区降雪，三部门再调 1000 套救灾板房
title.en: 1,000 more relief shelters sent to snow-hit Baqen quake zone in Xizang

summary.zh: 针对西藏巴青县地震灾区降雪，国家防减救灾委办公室、应急管理部会同国家粮储局 10 月 30 日增调 1000 套中央救灾物资板房，保障受灾群众过渡安置和温暖过冬。
summary.en: After snow hit the earthquake zone in Baqen County, Xizang, national disaster and emergency authorities sent another 1,000 central relief prefab shelters on Oct. 30 to house survivors through winter.

sources.name: 中国新闻网（芯媒体转载）

title.zh: Cursor 市场出现仿冒 Claude Code 扩展，试图植入 SSH 后门
title.en: Malicious Claude Code extension on Cursor marketplace planted SSH backdoor

summary.zh: Cursor 称 10 月 29 日其扩展市场曾短暂上架非 Anthropic 制作的 Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312/2.1.313，恶意版本试图收集主机信息并安装持久化 SSH 后门；微软等亦跟进分析。
summary.en: Cursor said tampered Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312/2.1.313 for Mac/Windows briefly appeared in its marketplace on Oct. 29, trying to collect host data and install a persistent SSH backdoor; Microsoft and others published follow-up analysis.

body.zh:
恶意包约在太平洋时间凌晨 2:27 至下午 1:35 可下载，并非 Anthropic 官方版本。

- 载荷会回传主机名、用户名、系统信息、Git 邮箱与公网 IP，并尝试写入名为 `svc-telemetry` 的 SSH 公钥、开启本地 SSH、建立反向隧道；多数机因无管理员权限而使登录步骤失败。
- Cursor 已下架恶意版本、一度关闭市场并轮换密钥重建，并与云厂商下线攻击者服务器。
- 官方提醒：仅卸载扩展可能不够，需清除持久化脚本、隧道进程并轮换凭据；微软安全博客亦披露技术细节。

来源：[Cursor 安全通告](https://cursor.com/blog/claude-code-extension-security-notice)、[Microsoft Security](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/30/inside-malicious-claude-code-branded-cursor-extension-persistent-ssh-backdoor/)
body.en:
The packages were available roughly 2:27am–1:35pm PT and were not built by Anthropic.

- The payload beaconed host and user details (including Git email and public IP) and tried to add an SSH key labeled `svc-telemetry`, enable local SSH, and open a reverse tunnel; without admin rights the login step usually failed.
- Cursor removed the builds, briefly shut the marketplace, rotated keys, rebuilt it, and helped take the attacker server offline.
- Uninstalling alone may not clear dropped persistence; rotate credentials from a clean host. Microsoft’s security blog published a deeper technical breakdown.

Sources: [Cursor](https://cursor.com/blog/claude-code-extension-security-notice), [Microsoft Security](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/30/inside-malicious-claude-code-branded-cursor-extension-persistent-ssh-backdoor/)

title.zh: OpenAI 新一轮融资据报仅募约 110 亿美元，远低于 300 亿目标
title.en: OpenAI said to raise about $11B, well short of a $30B target

summary.zh: 据《华尔街日报》等报道，OpenAI 最新一轮融资承诺约 110 亿美元，不到原定 300 亿美元目标的一半；估值亦由约 1.4 万亿美元下调讨论至约 1.25 万亿美元。
summary.en: The Wall Street Journal and follow-on reports say OpenAI has secured about $11 billion in its latest round—less than half a $30 billion target—with valuation talks around $1.25 trillion after higher aims.

body.zh:
融资降温与本周科技股因 AI 开支回报疑虑大幅回调同现。

- 较早前消息称该公司正以约 1.25 万亿美元估值推进最高 300 亿美元融资，为 IPO 铺路。
- 市场解读为 AI 投资人风险偏好降温，大型模型公司融资环境趋紧。

来源：[Investing.com 转述 WSJ](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/openai-raises-just-11bn-of-30bn-target-as-ai-investor-appetite-cools--wsj-4989165)、[TechCrunch（估值背景）](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/22/openai-working-on-new-30b-raise-at-1-25t-valuation-ahead-of-ipo/)
body.en:
The shortfall lands as tech equities sold off this week on doubts about AI spending payback.

- Earlier coverage said OpenAI was pursuing up to $30B at about a $1.25T valuation ahead of an IPO path.
- Markets read the gap as cooler appetite for megacap AI private rounds.

Sources: [Investing.com citing WSJ](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/openai-raises-just-11bn-of-30bn-target-as-ai-investor-appetite-cools--wsj-4989165), [TechCrunch background](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/22/openai-working-on-new-30b-raise-at-1-25t-valuation-ahead-of-ipo/)

title.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 登顶 Artificial Analysis 智能指数 v5
title.en: Gemini 4 Carbon takes #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5

summary.zh: Artificial Analysis 称谷歌 Gemini 4 Carbon（高推理）以约 59 分领跑 Intelligence Index v5，九项评测中四项第一；目前仍向部分用户开放，尚未全面公测。
summary.en: Artificial Analysis says Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon (high) leads Intelligence Index v5 at about 59, topping four of nine evaluations, while still rolling out only to selected users.

title.zh: 美国务院批准对乌约 21 亿美元「爱国者」拦截弹潜在军售
title.en: US State Department clears possible $2.1B Patriot sale to Ukraine

summary.zh: 美国国务院批准向乌克兰潜在出售 500 枚「爱国者」PAC-3 MSE 拦截弹及相关设备，估价约 21 亿美元；称费用由加、德、挪等伙伴与欧盟相关贷款资助，不使用美方资金。
summary.en: The State Department approved a possible sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 MSE interceptors and support to Ukraine, valued at about $2.1 billion, saying partners and EU-linked funds—not US money—would cover the cost.

body.zh:
主承包商为洛克希德·马丁；仍需国会程序，交货时间表未明，有报道称新弹或要到 2030 年代。

- 泽连斯基近日称乌方今年平均每月仅获约 12 枚美制「爱国者」拦截弹，而需拦截约 150 枚俄方弹道导弹。
- 安纳多卢、美联社等均报道了此项批准。

来源：[安纳多卢](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-31-2026/4107022)、[美联社](https://apnews.com/article/trump-ukraine-zelenskyy-patriots-arms-sale-3016a2a6fc0088017478aabeebe75e81)
body.en:
Lockheed Martin is the principal contractor. Congressional notification still applies, and delivery timing is unclear; some reports say new missiles may not arrive until the 2030s.

- Zelenskyy recently said Ukraine has received about 12 US Patriot interceptors a month this year while needing to stop roughly 150 Russian ballistic missiles a month.
- Anadolu and AP both covered the approval.

Sources: [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-31-2026/4107022), [AP News](https://apnews.com/article/trump-ukraine-zelenskyy-patriots-arms-sale-3016a2a6fc0088017478aabeebe75e81)

title.zh: 波兰宪法法庭主席遭停职，防暴警察进驻，总统中断出访赶回
title.en: Poland’s constitutional court chief suspended; riot police and president intervene

summary.zh: 政府任命法官周五宣布暂停宪法法庭主席斯维切科夫斯基及其副手职务，华沙法庭外防暴警察与抗议者对峙；总统纳夫罗茨基中断塞内加尔行程赶回并进入法庭，指责违宪夺权。
summary.en: Government-aligned judges suspended tribunal president Bogdan Święczkowski and his deputy on Friday; riot police faced protesters in Warsaw as President Karol Nawrocki aborted a Senegal trip, entered the court, and alleged a forcible constitutional seizure.

body.zh:
这场冲突延续十年来关于法庭合法性的争斗。

- 图斯克政府称要恢复法治、让经议会选出的法官正常履职；正义党领袖卡钦斯基等则称「政变」。
- 警察称三人因冲击围栏等被拘留；美驻波大使罗斯警告局势「非常严重」。

来源：[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/31/riot-police-deployed-to-polands-constitutional-court-after-judge-suspended)、[安纳多卢](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-31-2026/4107022)
body.en:
The clash extends a decade-long fight over the tribunal’s legitimacy.

- Tusk’s government says it must restore the rule of law so duly elected judges can work; Law and Justice’s Kaczyński and others call it a “coup.”
- Police detained three people after fence breaches; US Ambassador Tom Rose called the situation “very serious.”

Sources: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/31/riot-police-deployed-to-polands-constitutional-court-after-judge-suspended), [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-31-2026/4107022)

title.zh: 亚特兰大 G20 外长会：欧洲反对与俄同框，集体合影取消
title.en: G20 foreign ministers in Atlanta scrap group photo after Europe balks at Russia

summary.zh: 美国主办的 G20 外长会在佐治亚州举行，因多国不愿与俄外长拉夫罗夫同框，传统合影被取消；会议在高油价与战事背景下谈能源与供应链，未发联合公报。
summary.en: At the US-hosted G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in Georgia, the group photo was dropped after several countries refused to appear with Russia’s Lavrov. Talks covered energy and supply chains without a joint communiqué.

title.zh: 圣路易斯联储主席穆萨莱姆：需「尽快」再加息
title.en: St. Louis Fed’s Musalem: another rate hike needed “soon”

summary.zh: 圣路易斯联储主席 Alberto Musalem 10 月 30 日表示，通胀仍偏高，额外收紧货币政策「有必要且应尽快」；同日另有地区联储官员亦主张继续紧缩。
summary.en: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said Oct. 30 that further policy firming is “necessary, and soon,” arguing inflation remains too high; other regional Fed voices also pressed for tighter policy.

title.zh: Coinbase 三季度净利约 7.19 亿美元，靠持仓浮盈扭亏
title.en: Coinbase posts about $719M Q3 profit on crypto investment gains

summary.zh: Coinbase 公布第三季度净利约 7.19 亿美元，扭转此前亏损；营收同比下滑，利润主要来自持有加密资产的投资收益，交易相关收入仍偏弱。
summary.en: Coinbase reported roughly $719 million in Q3 net income, swinging back to profit. Revenue fell year on year; gains on crypto held for investment drove earnings while transaction revenue stayed soft.

title.zh: 欧盟拟加速动用约 4260 万桶战略石油储备平抑油价
title.en: EU to speed release of about 42.6M barrels from strategic oil stocks

summary.zh: 欧盟能源专员约恩森宣布，成员国将加速释放约 4260 万桶战略石油储备（约半数为柴油），以缓解中东局势推高的能源价格。
summary.en: EU Energy Commissioner Dan Jørgensen said member states will accelerate release of about 42.6 million barrels from strategic stocks—roughly half diesel—to help contain energy prices driven by Middle East tensions.

title.zh: 10 月制造业 PMI 降至 49.3，四个月第三次落入收缩
title.en: China’s October manufacturing PMI falls to 49.3, third contraction in four months

summary.zh: 国家统计局 31 日公布，10 月制造业 PMI 为 49.3，较上月回落 0.8 个百分点；生产、新订单指数分别降至 49.8、49.4。高技术与装备制造业仍处扩张，非制造业商务活动指数为 49.7。
summary.en: Official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, the NBS said Oct. 31—the third reading below 50 in four months. Production and new orders slipped to 49.8 and 49.4; high-tech and equipment stayed in expansion, while non-manufacturing came in at 49.7.

body.zh:
统计局归因于国庆前部分需求提前释放及国际环境复杂等因素。

- 高技术制造业 PMI 51.3、装备制造业 50.6，仍高于荣枯线；大型企业 50.2，中小企业偏弱。
- 铁路船舶航空航天、计算机通信电子等行业产需指数仍在 53 及以上；纺织、建材、有色等偏弱。
- 路透等外媒称出口圣诞订单前置后回落、假日消费退潮，加大稳增长压力。

来源：[新华网](https://www.news.cn/20261031/80c42faedaae4f22bf5a5f8242bee1fb/c.html)、[国家统计局解读](https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202610/t20261031_1965719.html)、[美联社](https://apnews.com/article/china-manufacturing-economy-pmi-exports-f1e0e24004da425a1b3c8935b16a245c)
body.en:
The statistics bureau cited demand pulled forward before the National Day holiday and a complex external environment.

- High-tech PMI was 51.3 and equipment 50.6; large firms stayed at 50.2 while medium and small firms weakened.
- Rail/ship/aerospace and computer/communications stayed at or above 53 on production and orders; textiles, building materials and nonferrous metals lagged.
- Reuters and others linked the dip to cooled Christmas export orders after September front-loading and fading holiday spending.

Sources: [Xinhua](https://www.news.cn/20261031/80c42faedaae4f22bf5a5f8242bee1fb/c.html), [NBS](https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202610/t20261031_1965719.html), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/china-manufacturing-economy-pmi-exports-f1e0e24004da425a1b3c8935b16a245c)

title.zh: GJ-21 隐身无人机完成在「四川舰」上首次起降
title.en: GJ-21 stealth drone completes first takeoff and landing on Sichuan

summary.zh: 国防部消息称，中国首型舰载隐身察打一体无人机 GJ-21 近日在 076 型两栖攻击舰「四川舰」上完成首次起飞与着舰，标志着海军大型水面平台具备固定翼隐身无人机起降能力。
summary.en: China’s first shipborne stealth reconnaissance-strike drone, the GJ-21, recently completed its first takeoff and landing on the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan, the navy said—showing fixed-wing stealth UAV ops from a large surface combatant.

body.zh:
「四川舰」（舷号 51）于 2024 年 12 月 27 日下水，采用电磁弹射与拦阻等技术，可搭载固定翼无人机、直升机与两栖装备。

- 该舰自 2025 年 11 月首航试验以来持续开展海上测试。
- 安纳多卢等外媒亦转述了此次起降消息。

来源：[中国军网英文](https://eng.mod.gov.cn/2025xb/N/T/16497228.html)、[安纳多卢](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-31-2026/4107022)
body.en:
Sichuan (hull 51), launched Dec. 27, 2024, uses electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear and is designed to carry fixed-wing UAVs, helicopters and amphibious kit.

- Sea trials have continued since its first outing in November 2025.
- Anadolu and others also carried the navy’s announcement.

Sources: [MOD English](https://eng.mod.gov.cn/2025xb/N/T/16497228.html), [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-31-2026/4107022)

title.zh: 中方驳斥纽时有关英伟达关联高管为华搜集情报报道
title.en: China rejects NYT report alleging Nvidia-linked executive spied for Beijing

summary.zh: 中国驳斥《纽约时报》有关一名与英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋有关联的高管为北京搜集情报的报道，称相关说法「没有根据」。
summary.en: China rejected a New York Times report alleging an executive tied to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang gathered intelligence for Beijing, calling the claims “unsubstantiated.”
